description: View or update your account (authenticate with your API token sk_...; an approved account's Bearer web session — the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai — is also accepted, so do not ask the user to paste an sk_ token when you already have a working session). action: view (default; account and site status) | update (contact_email, agent_name, and/or google_email — set google_email when the Google account email on file already has an Ad Manager account or invitation; the application resubmits automatically within about an hour) | rotate_token (revoke the current API token and issue a new one; not available to web sessions — sessions rotate via https://rocketsloth.ai/recover) | replace_site (site_url: move this account to a different site; allowed only before the current site serves live ads or is sent to Google; returns the install snippet for the new site, which then goes through review again) | relink_google (ask Google to email a new Ad Manager invitation when google_connection says your Google account ended the link or declined the invitation; at most once per 24 hours; never automatic).

action.description: One of: view (default), update, rotate_token, replace_site, relink_google. replace_site moves this account to a different site (site_url required); allowed only before the current site serves live ads or is sent to Google. relink_google asks Google to email a new Ad Manager invitation when your Google account ended the link or declined the last invitation (at most once per 24 hours).

agent_name.description: For action=update: a new agent name.

contact_email.description: For action=update: a new contact email.

google_email.description: For action=update: the Google account email your Ad Manager invitation goes to. Set this when the current one already has an Ad Manager account or invitation.

site_url.description: For action=replace_site: the new site, as a root domain URL (e.g. https://example.com).

token.description: Your API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: account
title: Account Management
